tactics.name: Reconnaissance
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to gather information they can use to plan future operations.

tactics.name: Resource Development
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to establish resources they can use to support operations.

tactics.name: Initial Access
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to get into your network.

tactics.name: Execution
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to run malicious code.

tactics.name: Persistence
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to keep their access.

tactics.name: Privilege Escalation
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to gain higher-level permissions.

tactics.name: Defense Evasion
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to avoid being detected.

tactics.name: Credential Access
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to steal account names and passwords.

tactics.name: Discovery
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to figure out your environment.

tactics.name: Lateral Movement
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to move through your environment.

tactics.name: Collection
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to gather data of interest to achieve their goal.

tactics.name: Exfiltration
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to steal data.

tactics.name: Command and Control
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to communicate with compromised systems to control them.

tactics.name: Impact
tactics.description: The adversary is trying to manipulate, interrupt, or destroy your systems and data.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.description: An adversary may attempt to take advantage of a weakness in an Internet-facing computer or program using software, data, or commands in order to cause unintended or unanticipated behavior.

techniques.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may gather information about the victim's identity that can be used during targeting.

techniques.name: Gather Victim Network Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may gather information about the victim's network that can be used during targeting.

techniques.name: Gather Victim Network Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may gather information about the victim's network infrastructure that can be used during targeting.

techniques.name: Phishing for Information
techniques.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to elicit sensitive information that can be used during targeting.

techniques.name: Phishing
techniques.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems. All forms of phishing are attacks that attempt to acquire sensitive information for use in further attacks.

techniques.name: Replication Through Removable Media
techniques.description: Adversaries may move onto systems, possibly those on disconnected or air-gapped networks, by copying malware to removable media which may be used by a common and expected user activity such as copying data from one storage device to another.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.description: Adversaries may compromise software, firmware, or hardware throughout the supply chain of an organization in order to introduce malware or backdoors during initial installation.

techniques.name: Trusted Relationship
techniques.description: Adversaries may breach or otherwise leverage organizations who have access to victim networks, systems, or data by compromising the trusted third party and leveraging the access granted to them.

techniques.name: Drive-by Compromise
techniques.description: A user visits a website over the normal course of browsing and is targeted for exploitation by a malicious script embedded in the website. Vulnerabilities in browsers, browser plugins, and web applications that do not patch are common attack vectors.

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism
techniques.description: Adversaries may circumvent mechanisms that limit the ability to perform privileged operations to avoid detection, masking, or altering the intended way of modifying the system.

techniques.name: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
techniques.description: Adversaries may achieve persistence by executing malicious content triggered during boot or user logon.

techniques.name: BITS Jobs
techniques.description: Adversaries may abuse BITS jobs to persistently execute code and perform latency-obfuscated data exfiltration.

techniques.name: Impair Defenses
techniques.description: Adversaries may maliciously modify components of a victim environment in order to hinder or disable defensive capabilities.
